definition: Target problem/domain and breadth of the semantic model or framework.
comparison_rule: Do not penalize intentionally narrower work; compare only when relevant to a Paper-1 claim.

definition: Explicit use of foundational ontology, OntoUML/UFO/gUFO or comparable identity/category discipline.
Whether the work explicitly distinguishes risk phenomenon/event/scenario from information artifacts such as register entries/descriptions.
comparison_rule: A material Paper-1 differentiator only if SemRisk actually implements/evaluates it.

definition: Whether assessment process/activity is distinguished from its contextual result/estimate/rating.
Whether domain/risk state is explicitly separated from workflow/record status.
comparison_rule: Narrower works are `not_in_scope` rather than scored negatively.

definition: Explicit modeling of source/condition/trigger/event/consequence and causal vs association/dependency semantics.
comparison_rule: Propagation/formal reasoning prior art prevents novelty from mere relation depth.

definition: Support for time/context/history/reassessment without forcing new risk identity.
comparison_rule: Iterative guidance alone is not identical to formal temporal semantics.

definition: Links to objectives, capabilities, processes, controls and accountable actors.
comparison_rule: Generic EA-risk linkage is established prior art.

definition: Architecture allowing reusable Core plus bounded domain/profile specialization.
comparison_rule: A planned architecture is not counted as evaluated implementation.

definition: Material Health/Pharma domain grounding or case evidence.
Explicit provenance from source/dataset to semantic decisions/mappings.
comparison_rule: Missing publication detail is `not_reported`, not proof of absence.

definition: Availability of OWL/RDF/SHACL/rules/formal constraints or executable semantic artifacts.
Use of CQs or structured semantic evaluation linked to claims.
comparison_rule: Do not equate reasoner PASS with semantic validity.

definition: Mapping from real operational schema/data into semantic model/application.
comparison_rule: Risk-register KG/RDB mapping is prior art.

definition: Persistent IDs, release/version/IRI, artifact bindings and reproducibility controls.
comparison_rule: Current mutable repository is weaker than immutable release binding.

definition: Whether limitations/access/validation gaps are explicitly documented.
comparison_rule: SemRisk must show its own weaknesses alongside comparator gaps.
